chain.title: Pressure Enters the Workshop
chain.desc: Crafted in a crafting table from iron ingots around a piston, and it is the machine that presses ingots and blocks into plates.

chain.title: Flattened Beginnings
chain.desc: Produced by running an iron ingot or an iron block through a powered Compressor.

chain.title: The Alloy Hearth
chain.desc: Crafted from iron plates, redstone and a vanilla blast furnace, and it is the only machine that alloys metals in this mod.

chain.title: Iron, Only Angrier
chain.desc: Alloyed in the Etrionic Blast Furnace from an iron ingot plus coal or charcoal.

chain.title: Hull Stock
chain.desc: Compressed from steel ingots or steel blocks, and it is the base part for almost every rocket component.

chain.title: Something to Breathe Through
chain.desc: Crafted from steel plates and a steel rod, and it is the piece that connects a gas tank to a space suit.

chain.title: First Skin for Vacuum
chain.desc: Crafted from steel plates, wool, a gas tank and the Oxygen Gear, and the full four-piece set is required to survive any airless world.

chain.title: Cracking the Black Ooze
chain.desc: Crafted from steel plates, a bucket and a furnace, and it refines crude oil pumped from ocean Oil Well structures into rocket fuel.

chain.title: Where Rockets Are Born
chain.desc: Crafted from steel plates, steel blocks, iron rods, a redstone torch and a crafting table, and every rocket tier is assembled in its dedicated grid.

chain.title: Ignition on the Home World
chain.desc: Assembled in the NASA Workbench from a rocket nose cone, steel blocks, rocket fins, a steel tank and a steel engine, then placed on a Launch Pad and fuelled.

chain.title: Grey Dust Underfoot
chain.desc: The Moon is the tier 1 destination in the mod's planet data and has no breathable atmosphere, so a full oxygen-fed suit is mandatory.

chain.title: The Lunar Alloy
chain.desc: Smelted or blasted from Moon Desh Ore or raw desh, both of which only generate below the Moon's surface.

chain.title: A Bubble of Home
chain.desc: Crafted from desh plates, a fan, a large gas tank, an Oxygen Loader and Oxygen Gear, and it floods a sealed room with breathable air.

chain.title: Desh-Clad Ascent
chain.desc: Assembled in the NASA Workbench using desh blocks, a desh tank and a desh engine in place of the tier 1 steel parts.

chain.title: Rust-Coloured Wastes
chain.desc: Mars is flagged tier 2 in the planet data, runs at roughly minus sixty-five degrees and is patrolled by Martian Raptors.

chain.title: Red Planet Metal
chain.desc: Smelted or blasted from Mars Ostrum Ore or raw ostrum, which generate in Martian stone.

chain.title: Armour That Holds Air
chain.desc: Crafted from ostrum plates, a netherite chestplate, Oxygen Gear and a large gas tank, giving a far deeper oxygen reserve than the basic suit.

chain.title: Ostrum Bound for the Inner System
chain.desc: Assembled in the NASA Workbench from ostrum blocks, an ostrum tank and an ostrum engine.

chain.title: Furnace Beneath the Clouds
chain.desc: Venus sits at tier 3 with an ambient temperature of roughly 464 degrees, and its wastes spawn Moglers, Zombified Pygros and Sulfur Creepers.

chain.title: Forged in the Hot Place
chain.desc: Smelted or blasted from Venus Calorite Ore or raw calorite, the highest-tier metal in the mod.

chain.title: The Scorched Grey Deltas
chain.desc: Mercury is the other tier 3 world in the planet data, a mob-free expanse of stone deltas holding Mercury Iron Ore.

chain.title: Reaching Another Star
chain.desc: Assembled in the NASA Workbench from calorite blocks, a calorite tank and a calorite engine, the only rocket that leaves the Solar System.

chain.title: Snowfall Around Proxima
chain.desc: Glacio is the tier 4 world in the Proxima Centauri system, breathable but freezing, and home to Glacian Rams and Ice Shard Ore.

chain.title: Wings of Molten Calorite
chain.desc: Crafted from calorite plates, a calorite engine, a calorite tank, an Etrionic Capacitor and the Netherite Space Suit, and it grants powered flight.

notes: Item set = 411 stems of assets/ad_astra/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys across every assets/*/lang/en_us.json in the jar; every id above is a member of that set. Planet tiers and dimension ids read from data/ad_astra/planets/*.json: moon tier 1, mars tier 2, venus and mercury tier 3, glacio tier 4 (Proxima Centauri system); earth is minecraft:overworld so it is not used as a dim: step. Verified dimensions in data/ad_astra/dimension/: earth_orbit, glacio, glacio_orbit, mars, mars_orbit, mercury, mercury_orbit, moon, moon_orbit, venus, venus_orbit. Orbit dimensions were deliberately left out of the chain because they are transit-only. DROPPED as unverifiable or unobtainable: ad_astra:etrium_ingot, ad_astra:etrium_block, ad_astra:etrium_plate, ad_astra:etrium_rod, ad_astra:etrium_nugget, ad_astra:etrium_panel, ad_astra:etrium_plateblock, ad_astra:etrium_factory_block, ad_astra:encased_etrium_block and ad_astra:photovoltaic_vesnium_cell - these exist as items and block models but have no recipe, loot table, or worldgen source anywhere in the jar (only the vesnium/etrium block drop-self loot tables), so there is no in-game way to obtain them in 1.15.20. Also dropped: the fluid names cryo_fuel, fuel, hydrogen, oil and oxygen, which have lang entries but no item model - only their *_bucket items are real items. ad_astra:rendered_item and ad_astra:etrionic_capacitor_off have models but no lang key and are internal. No kill: steps were used: none of the 20 verified entities (lunarian, corrupted_lunarian, martian_raptor, mogler, zombified_mogler, pygro, pygro_brute, zombified_pygro, sulfur_creeper, star_crawler, glacian_ram, air_vortex, ice_spit, lander and the four rocket/rover entities) gate any recipe or dimension, so they belong in optional side quests rather than the spine. Oil is confirmed to come from the ad_astra:oil_well jigsaw structure, whose biome tag targets #minecraft:is_ocean and #minecraft:has_structure/ocean_monument, i.e. Overworld oceans. Structures present: lunar_tower, lunarian_village, mars_temple, moon_dungeon, oil_well, pygro_tower, pygro_village, venus_bullet.
